title: policy
description: One immutable version of an investor's policy: qualitative objectives plus rules. A version is never rewritten; any change creates version+1 with parent_version set. Semantic rules (byb_contracts.validate_policy): parent_version is null iff version == 1, else parent_version < version; rule_id and objective_id values are unique; a rule's objective_id refers to an objective in the same version; supersedes/superseded_by links are mutual and stay inside the version; content_hash == 'sha256:' + sha256 of the canonical JSON of the policy without content_hash (byb_contracts.compute_content_hash).

change_note.description: Why this version exists, e.g. 'Issuer cap raised from 0.10 to 0.30 by the user (challenge ch-...)'.
